Definition: from G5228 and the base of G939; to transcend, i.e. (figuratively) to overreach:--go beyond.
BiblicalUsage: hyperbaínō turns up where the Bible says to go beyond, to transgress. In 1 Thessalonians 4:6, the text says "That no [man] go beyond and defraud his brother in [any] matter."
TheologicalSignificance: This one, hyperbaínō, I take at face value: to go beyond, to transgress.
